## Verification

## Security Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, cookies, database dumps, or private logs are committed.
- [ ] New endpoints are authenticated or intentionally public.
- [ ] User input is validated with Zod or equivalent runtime checks.
- [ ] Logs do not include sensitive values.
